browse.title: Browse Listings
browse.body: All match and exchange listings across the platform are displayed here. Each card shows the team name, type, level, and number of applications. Look for listings with the "Open" status.

status.title: Understanding Status
status.body: Check the colored badge in the top-left of each listing card to see its status.
status.matched: Matched (blue) — An opponent has been confirmed
status.cancelled: Cancelled (red) — The listing has been withdrawn

types.title: Types, Categories & Levels
types.body: Listing cards show the type, category, and level. Find listings that match your team's conditions.
types.competition: Match — Listings for official or practice matches
types.practice: Practice — Listings for joint practice or guest participation
types.exchange: Exchange — Friendly matches or event-style exchanges
types.recruit: Recruit — Listings for substitute or one-time players

create.title: Post a Listing from Your Team
create.body: To find opponents or exchange partners, create a listing from the Matching tab on your team page.
create.step4: Enter the title, type, and category, then tap "Create"
